# kvv1

```go
import kvv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/kv/v1"
```

Package kvv1 is the kv/v1 contract: an app's key-value store. Named JSON values (an app's settings, an extension's state) kept without a collection or a migration, in PocketBase's own \_params table, so they ride along in backups.

Two halves:

  - The helpers in this package ([Get](#get), [Set](#set), [Delete](#delete), [List](#list)) are how Go code (an extension, a hook) reads and writes the store. They work on the app's database directly, inside a transaction when given one, and need no provider.
  - The wire API at /api/\_c/kv/v1 (superusers only) is how the CLI, MCP and a dashboard read and change values. Its provider (ext/kv) serves it over the same helpers, and gives page code $kv.

Each value is one \_params row whose id is [Prefix](#prefix) + its name ("kv:storytime/settings"), so a name can never meet PocketBase's own params ("settings") or another extension's rows. Names are 1 to [MaxNameLength](#maxnamelength) characters: letters, digits and \_ - . : / , starting with a letter or digit. Use a prefix of your own ("myext/...") to keep your names apart from others'. A name starting with \_ ("\_myext/secret") is private: only Go code reaches it, through the helpers; the wire API and $kv never do.

Source: [`ext/contracts/kv/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/kv/v1).

## Constants

<a id="maxnamelength"></a>

```go
const MaxNameLength = 128
```

MaxNameLength is the longest name.

<a id="maxvaluebytes"></a>

```go
const MaxValueBytes = 1 << 20
```

MaxValueBytes is the largest value, as JSON.

<a id="prefix"></a>

```go
const Prefix = "kv:"
```

Prefix starts the \_params id of every value in the store: name "storytime/settings" is row "kv:storytime/settings".

<a id="privateprefix"></a>

```go
const PrivatePrefix = "_"
```

PrivatePrefix starts a private name ("\_llm/settings"): Go code reads and writes it through these helpers, but the wire API (HTTP, the CLI, MCP) and page code's $kv never reach or list it. Keep secrets (API keys, signing keys) there.

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Store]("kv/v1", extkit.One)
```

Contract is kv/v1.

<a id="errinvalidname"></a>

```go
var ErrInvalidName = &extkit.Error{Code: "invalid_name", Message: "a name is 1 to 128 characters: letters, digits and _ - . : /, starting with a letter or digit (_ first makes it private)", Status: 400}
```

ErrInvalidName: the name is empty, too long or has a character names can't have.

<a id="errinvalidvalue"></a>

```go
var ErrInvalidValue = &extkit.Error{Code: "invalid_value", Message: "the value must be JSON of at most 1 MiB", Status: 400}
```

ErrInvalidValue: the value isn't JSON, or is bigger than [MaxValueBytes](#maxvaluebytes).

<a id="errnotfound"></a>

```go
var ErrNotFound = &extkit.Error{Code: "not_found", Message: "no value under that name", Status: 404}
```

ErrNotFound: no value under that name.

<a id="errprivate"></a>

```go
var ErrPrivate = &extkit.Error{Code: "private", Message: "names starting with _ are private to the app's Go code", Status: 403}
```

ErrPrivate: the name is private (starts with \_), so only Go code on the app reaches it.

<a id="w"></a>

```go
var W = extkit.NewWire(Contract, "kv", func(inner Store, g *extkit.Guard[Store]) Store {
	return &guardStore{inner, g}
},
	extkit.Op[Store]{
		Name:   "list",
		Desc:   "Returns the values whose names start with prefix (all of them when it's empty), sorted by name. Private names (starting with _) are left out.",
		Method: "GET",
		Path:   "",
		Scope:  "kv:read",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(ListInput{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Store, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in ListInput
			if err := extkit.DecodeQuery(req.Query, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.List(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
	extkit.Op[Store]{
		Name:   "get",
		Desc:   "Returns one value. A name with no value is a not_found error; a private name is a private error.",
		Method: "GET",
		Path:   "get",
		Scope:  "kv:read",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(Key{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Store, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in Key
			if err := extkit.DecodeQuery(req.Query, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.Get(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
	extkit.Op[Store]{
		Name:   "set",
		Desc:   "Stores a JSON value under a name, replacing any value it had.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "set",
		Scope:  "kv",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(SetInput{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Store, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in SetInput
			if err := extkit.DecodeInput(req.JSON, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.Set(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
	extkit.Op[Store]{
		Name:   "delete",
		Desc:   "Removes a value. Deleting a name with no value is not an error.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "delete",
		Scope:  "kv",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(Key{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Store, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in Key
			if err := extkit.DecodeInput(req.JSON, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return nil, impl.Delete(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
)
```

W is kv/v1's wire side: routes at /api/\_c/kv/v1/\<op>, action hooks, MCP tools and the client.

## Functions

### Delete

```go
func Delete(app core.App, name string) error
```

Delete removes name's value. Deleting a name with no value is not an error.

Example:

```go
_ = kvv1.Delete(app, "myapp/settings")
```

### Get

```go
func Get(app core.App, name string, dst any) (found bool, err error)
```

Get decodes name's value into dst (as json.Unmarshal). found is false, and dst untouched, when it has none.

	var s Settings
	if _, err := kvv1.Get(app, "storytime/settings", &s); err != nil { ... }

Example:

```go
var settings struct{ Theme string }
found, err := kvv1.Get(app, "myapp/settings", &settings)
if err != nil {
	return
}
if !found {
	settings.Theme = "light"
}
fmt.Println(settings.Theme)
```

### IsPrivate

```go
func IsPrivate(name string) bool
```

IsPrivate says whether name is private (starts with [PrivatePrefix](#privateprefix)).

### MoveParam

```go
func MoveParam(app core.App, fromID, name string) (moved bool, err error)
```

MoveParam moves the \_params row fromID (an extension's own row from before kv/v1) to name, once: when name has no value yet, it gets the row's value and times, and the row is deleted. When name already has one, a leftover row is just deleted. moved says whether a value was moved. PocketBase's own rows and the store's rows can't be moved.

### MoveParamOnce

```go
func MoveParamOnce(app core.App, fromID, name string) error
```

MoveParamOnce is [MoveParam](#moveparam) at most once per app and row, for a load path that runs often: after the first call that succeeds, later ones return at once.

### OnDelete

```go
func OnDelete(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *Key) error)
```

OnDelete binds fn to delete calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

```go
func OnGet(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *Key) error)
```

OnGet binds fn to get calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

### OnList

```go
func OnList(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *ListInput) error)
```

OnList binds fn to list calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

### OnSet

```go
func OnSet(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *SetInput) error)
```

OnSet binds fn to set calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

### ParamID

```go
func ParamID(name string) string
```

ParamID is the \_params id that holds name's value.

### Set

```go
func Set(app core.App, name string, v any) error
```

Set stores v (as json.Marshal) under name, replacing any value it had.

Example:

```go
err := kvv1.Set(app, "myapp/settings", map[string]any{"theme": "dark"})
if err != nil {
	return
}
```

### ValidName

```go
func ValidName(name string) error
```

ValidName returns [ErrInvalidName](#errinvalidname) unless name can name a value: after an optional [PrivatePrefix](#privateprefix), a letter or digit, then letters, digits and \_ - . : / , at most [MaxNameLength](#maxnamelength) in all.

## Types

### Client

```go
type Client struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Client is kv/v1 over HTTP, for the CLI and other apps. It implements Store; the token it was made with is the credential, so the extkit.Auth argument is ignored.

### NewClient

```go
func NewClient(baseURL, token string, hc *http.Client) *Client
```

NewClient calls kv/v1 on the app at baseURL with token (a PocketBase auth token or an API token).

func (c *Client) Delete(ctx context.Context, _ extkit.Auth, in Key) error
```

```

```

```

### Entry

```go
type Entry struct {
	Name    string          `json:"name"`
	Value   json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
	Created time.Time       `json:"created"`
	Updated time.Time       `json:"updated"`
}
```

Entry is one stored value.

### List

```go
func List(app core.App, prefix string) ([]Entry, error)
```

List returns the values whose names start with prefix (every value when it's empty), sorted by name.

Example:

```go
entries, err := kvv1.List(app, "myapp/")
if err != nil {
	return
}
for _, e := range entries {
	fmt.Println(e.Name, e.Updated)
}
```

### Lookup

```go
func Lookup(app core.App, name string) (e Entry, found bool, err error)
```

Lookup returns name's stored value; found is false when it has none.

### SetRaw

```go
func SetRaw(app core.App, name string, raw json.RawMessage) (Entry, error)
```

SetRaw stores raw JSON under name and returns the stored entry.

### Key

```go
type Key struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}
```

Key names a value.

### ListInput

```go
type ListInput struct {
	Prefix string `json:"prefix,omitempty"`
}
```

ListInput picks the values to list.

### Listing

```go
type Listing struct {
	Entries []Entry `json:"entries"`
}
```

Listing is the values [Store.List](#store) found.

### SetInput

```go
type SetInput struct {
	Name  string          `json:"name"`
	Value json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
}
```

SetInput is a value to store.

### Store

```go
type Store interface {
	// List returns the values whose names start with prefix (all of them when it's empty), sorted by name. Private names
	// (starting with _) are left out.
	//
	//op: GET / scope=kv:read
	List(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in ListInput) (Listing, error)

	// Get returns one value. A name with no value is a not_found error; a private name is a private error.
	//
	//op: GET get scope=kv:read
	Get(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in Key) (Entry, error)

	// Set stores a JSON value under a name, replacing any value it had.
	//
	//op: POST set scope=kv
	Set(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in SetInput) (Entry, error)

	// Delete removes a value. Deleting a name with no value is not an error.
	//
	//op: POST delete scope=kv
	Delete(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in Key) error
}
```

Store reads and changes the app's key-value store.
